access: Diagnostic worker receives first development mouse A only; no B, C, D or source requests. Later smoke may receive authorized development AB only after diagnosis and amendment.

diagnosis.real_coordinates: All intercept coordinates plus 16 uniformly seeded coordinates using seed 20261012, initial and terminal parameters for each fit
diagnosis.trace: Every objective call and accepted iteration; aggregate numerical diagnostics only, no parameter or neural arrays exported
diagnosis.original_trace_warning: Original trajectories were not recorded; new trajectories are prospective replays, never original measurements.

acceptance: Every mandatory fit converges with finite scores; no denominator change or seed pruning. Independent oracles and isolation pass first.
M4_policy: M3 amendment does not silently amend the separately frozen M4 optimizer or shared-offset policy.
stop: Any mandatory gate failure stops continuation; M6 final evaluation remains locked.
